sources.entry: Bitwarden - Cross-platform password management solutions for individuals, teams, and business organizations.

summary.one_liner: Bitwarden's desktop password manager app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Electron and Angular; the README marks this repository as archived.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes the Bitwarden desktop app as written in Electron and Angular, installing on Windows, macOS, and Linux distributions. It gives build requirements (Node.js 16.13.1 or greater, NPM v8, plus Visual C++ tooling on Windows and build-essential, libsecret, and libglib packages on Linux) and run steps using npm ci and npm run electron. It explains how native messaging works with browser extensions: a dist build starts a lightweight proxy baked into the binary, and enabling desktop integration writes native manifests to disk. It also covers contribution guidelines (PRs against master), a Prettier migration procedure, and a git blame ignore-revs setting. The README states the repository is archived and development has moved elsewhere.
use_cases: run the Bitwarden desktop password manager locally
develop or debug the Bitwarden desktop app
debug browser extension native messaging with a desktop app
build an Electron and Angular desktop app from source
contribute to the Bitwarden desktop codebase
how_to_run: npm run dist: (build distribution version, needed for native messaging debugging)
notable: Cross-platform desktop client for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Native messaging proxy for communicating with browser extensions
Desktop integration writes browser native messaging manifests
Prettier formatting migration with documented merge steps
caveats: Repository is archived; the README directs users to another location for future development
Windows builds need Visual Studio C++ toolset, Microsoft Build Tools 2015, and Windows 10 SDK 17134
Linux builds need several system packages installed first
